newsitem.title: USA: TransCanada files for US$200 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada files for US$200 mln in debt.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in debt securities.
The $200 million worth of junior subordinated debentures due 2045 is denominated as eight million Canadian Originated Preferred Securities (COPrS), the filing said.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including the repayment of short-term debt incurred from the financing of its non-regulated businesses, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Smith Barney Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, PaineWebber Inc and Prudential Securities Inc.
The company, based in Calgary, Alberta, is a Canadian corporation with operations principally in the transportation of natural gas and marketing of energy commodities.
